title: Colossus - The Greatest Secret in the History of Computing
summary: Chris Shore of the Centre for Computing History explains how Colossus was built, how it worked, and how it affected the course of World War II. It is an hour-long museum lecture on the codebreaking computer.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an excellent deep dive on the real Colossus, full of stories about unsung engineers.

quote.text: It was very worth the watch, lots of fascinating tidbits including some stories of unsung heroes / geniuses.
